notes.title: Update Notice - v4 Patch 30f
notes.notes:
I've just pushed a new update live for Pogostuck. It does not include new content but has been in the works for ages still.
It uses a new system to establish P2P connections from lobbies. Dead lobbies where you cannot establish connections to most if not all other players (indicated by an X in the live ranking) should be a thing of the past now.
Now that the lobby owner does not dictate the player list anymore it was necessary to rewrite the rubber band syncing code. Should you experience issues with this or stumble upon another major bug please let me know!

Please note that the new version is incompatible with the old version, so players on different versions might not see each other and rubber bands may break or not function at all. When trying to play with friends please make sure you are all running the new version (you can check the version in the Misc Options menu).

Apart from this rewrite the update includes some bug fixes, internal work to prepare for Map 3 as well as a new button in the Multiplayer (Friends) menu to join a different lobby.

notes.title: Map 3 Update - Pause Effects
notes.notes:
Work on Map 3 is slowly but surely coming to an end.

Recently I have implemented a new type of customization, that is Pause Effects.
You most likely noticed the addition to the Wardrobe menu early 2021 already. So far it only featured the ice freeze effect you unlock when you beat the Map 1 ice mode.
In the future you will find 8 new pause effects:

[previewyoutube=_a4QT9CKrhU;full]VIDEO[/previewyoutube]
Use them to customize your pogo character even further or to interact with other players. Point them in the right direction, rate their moves or show them your affection:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023786/00c93d238f1bb359e66842f641f2a56084438a87.png

The Friends menu has been renamed to the Multiplayer menu and now lists an option to opt into pause effect related co-op functionality. Go ham with your friends and shortcut everything by jumping on helper blocks, grapes and even mushrooms (all indicated by eyes on said objects) or help out a stranger in need:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023786/b6c734fb6b63beb259085b04c718ea62111c01ce.png

Note that using this feature will give time penalties as well as prevent you from getting certain if not most Map 3 achievements until you reset your run (a new entry in the Multiplayer menu notes if you have used co-op functionality, including rubber bands, this run). Additionally, the pause effect helper functionality is only available in Map 3 and will never be added to Map 1 nor Map 2.


If you paid close attention you might have noticed the pogo stick I was using. Behold, the Pro Stick:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023786/fc744c02e9d628a28347feada93367b39372b096.png

The Pro Stick is made up of only the finest materials. A highly durable but lightweight carbon fiber hull as well as aircraft-grade aluminum reduce the weight by 37% compared to the basic pogo stick.
Non-porous water-repellent rubber grips with True Gibster™ linings give the user maximum control.
While lacking in comfort, the water-permeable Pro Stick foot pedals deliver ultimate grip, increasing confidence and ultimately results.

Pre-order now for only 279,-Eur. Some terms and conditions may apply.

notes.title: Happy Second Anniversary, Patch 22
notes.notes:
Two years ago Pogostuck: Rage With Your Friends released on Steam, so today marks the day of its second anniversary! My heartfelt thanks to everyone who has played the game! ːwinter2019happybulbː

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023786/0e7f61e74bfe529c3315dfb4dd68d41ff15818cd.png

To celebrate both map 1 and map 2 now feature some more or less subtle birthday decoration for one week. Let's have a look at what else has changed in the most recent and the previous two patches:

The Sleepy Hat had been temporarily replaced with a red Santa Hat over the festive season. As some people enjoyed differently colored hats I've implemented an item color system, allowing players to choose their own hat colors. This only works for the Sleepy Hat for now but might be expanded to other items in the future. Additionally, you can now set the background color in the video options menu if you prefer to play with background rendering switched off:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023786/38b8cb8ba7b0fefb5c8999001feaf1960e0e4a52.png

The replay interface (which can be found by selecting a replay from the leaderboard while playing map 1 or map 2) has been reworked and improved. It now features the ability to easily toggle between multiple replays and to even manipulate them in sync:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023786/46d8209e0c4a63456e2b5f8487749901a509529d.png

The matchmaking usually only looks for lobbies halfway around the globe. In some scenarios this could lead to players from certain regions to only be able to play with a handful of other players unless they manually joined lobbies. To combat this a so called Lobby distance filter (to be found in the in-game Friends menu) has been introduced where players can choose between standard and now world-wide searches. The downside of being matched with players from all around the globe is potentially fluctuating ping or even packet loss, leading to other players seemingly teleporting around the map.


For multiple weeks before the release of map 2 I was trying to add an object or a mechanic at 650m+ and onward that prevented many of the deep falls (in particular those from 800m down to 550m or 450m even). The issue was that all of those conflicted with the general gameplay and intended route going up in that section. At launch a big but invisible jellyfish from the loot mode was in the map still, stemming from my last attempt of trying to prevent said falls.
With patch 20 I finally added a helping wind similar to that in map 1 next to the moais:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023786/e10b157e736667c26fd68ce4f0f1374950ca55f9.png

This wind slightly guides you onto the pillar below falling down, possibly allowing for a recovery jump. It's very well possible still to fall in the gap between. Please note from my previous paragraph that this has always been the intended design of that area, I just didn't know how to implement it gracefully.

Also, the movement of the ladybugs in the early slopes area of map 2 has been adjusted so they no longer block the view on the player and the pogo stick. This was unwanted behavior because of its random nature, in stark contrast to the static clover leaves in the same area that might block your view as well.


The updates furthermore include general bug fixes, including a mean bug where one or two bytes behind long menu text strings could be overwritten in some cases. This might have randomly led to erroneous behavior and crashes in the past, so general stability should be improved now.
A more robust save system has been introduced that prevents the rare loss of progress or a false change in game modes when the mode framework is changed internally.


Thank you for reading, have fun and see you at the top!

notes.title: Patch 16 - Map 2 Upside-Down Mode, Wardrobe Setups
notes.notes:
Patch 16 just went live. It includes a new game mode for Map 2, the Upside-Down mode:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023786/6bd9bb43a56b3e0f36fb6f0a23e0dd1fb3093a4b.png

That ominous portal only appears once you've completed map 2 at least once. Hop into it and your world will turn upside down, meanwhile teleporting you to the end of the level. If you manage to climb back to the bed at the start of map 2 you will be awarded a new option in the wardrobe menu, the ability to turn your head upside down:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023786/0f23a2d0f62332f480024843f975e0c0f5b65e55.png

Be warned though, this mode is extremely difficult and suited for experts only!


Additionally, the update adds Save and Load Setup options to the wardrobe menu, allowing you to store 5 of your favorite character customization setups.


As always, have fun and good luck!

notes.title: Patch 14 - New Ice Mode, Tech Improvements
notes.notes:
Patch 14 just went live. It includes a new game mode for Map 1, the Ice mode:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023786/401311a443b947a9a2c52b799acfd68310171305.png

In that one, as you might have guessed already, 99% of all surfaces are slippery. A true challenge for everyone who has beaten Map 1 previously! You can however play the Map 1 extra modes now as well even if you've never reached the finish line (they appear once you reach experience level 10, or if you type POGO in the main menu).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023786/00b38d2baaa2359b050c727197c226f019ae7505.png

Activating the ice mode switches the level's theme to a snowy landscape until you reload the level. This means you can play regular modes (i.e. without surfaces being slippery) in that winter landscape if you so desire.

Beating the ice mode unlocks a special ability to show off, you freeze when you press pause. This does not count as an unlockable item and it does not contribute to Pogo Mastery.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023786/52d3f3c39500583701dd8b5838df13030028a8ff.png


The update includes some other tech improvements:

For as long as the game existed there has been an issue with the movement code where you could get stuck and potentially even glitch into geometry slightly while turning around acute angles/ objects (such as for example a pointy branch). This may be fixed now, or at least should barely ever happen anymore. Not being able to rotate when you're right next to a wall or some other geometry is not a bug.

Because of performance problems on multiple machines the ice and flower particles on Map 1 have been replaced by single GPU animated objects each which try to emulate the old behavior. You can always go back to the old style by selecting the corresponding option in the Video options menu.

Fixed/ circumvented an engine related issue that could cut down performance drastically when you had a Steam Input device plugged in (such as a Switch Pro Controller or a PS4 gamepad, unless you specifically told Steam to not recognize those).

General code related performance improvements on Map 1.


Have fun and see you around! ☃️

notes.title: Major update v3 released.
notes.notes:
A major update just went live.
The main feature is a new game mode titled Skate With Your Friends.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023786/96842eaf0177ff38c9a0375b901af7faf95f83e5.gif

A short gameplay trailer (the same as on the Steam store page): 
ttps://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mFW8dBfVTEM
Skate for fun or chain all kinds of tricks into crazy minute-long combos and compete in leaderboards or live rankings. There's Flip and Grab tricks, Grinds, Manuals, Wallrides, Wallplants and Spine Transfers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023786/4ae35559dd32d0ab2edb3d5a390097fea8e8ae45.png

There's three new unlockables, Bunny Ears, a Sleepyhead night cap and Wings (+ robe). Make 50k, 150k and 500k point combos to unlock them. (Pressing and holding down the Special button is the key to making long combos, as well as doing grab tricks in pipes to ramp up the base score.)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023786/2fb35b31fd56e36c1744e0cc149f8618620a80d8.png

The update includes some other smaller changes, such as the usual bug fixes as well as a redesigned mode selection for the Adventure mode for people who have beaten the game at least once. You now select the Skipless or Invisible mode by jumping against the corresponding block from below.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023786/1472c6c76d7990ca562eb06b737741692f27d963.png

Have fun and good luck! :)

notes.title: v2 - Patch 12: Major bug fix addressing random crashes
notes.notes:
I have found and fixed a rather severe memory leak in my sound engine where some memory was not being freed after it had been streamed in. Apart from some files such as the ambient loops in Loot With Your Friends this mainly affected music tracks.

The game then would crash for anyone with in-game music on just playing long enough (depending on how often music played) and the game window would just either close silently/ immediately or a DirectX error message would appear.

This bug has been in the game ever since and probably caused hundreds and thousands of crashes for all kinds of players. Sorry for not finding it sooner!

It has been fixed in the recent version v2 - Patch 12.

The patch includes some other minor changes, mostly in preparation for the next update called Skate With Your Friends, coming very soon:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023786/19ccdb2cddd63f06108552ff4073f709d50291a4.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023786/4ae35559dd32d0ab2edb3d5a390097fea8e8ae45.png

notes.title: Major update v2 released.
notes.notes:
A major update just went live.
The main feature is a new game mode titled Loot With Your Friends.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023786/481bdc4a0df34895bde651cc7925e8a9a64403a2.png

Explore randomly (procedurally) generated dungeons, increasing in difficulty and danger the deeper you go, and collect all kinds of treasure to get the highest score.
Fire projectiles from your pogo stick to kill enemies and propel yourself forward.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023786/7a2e4b38de897c0c486e41b627174e55ded153f2.gif

There's two new unlockables, a Jetpack boost effect and an animated Artefact pogo stick. Reach 5000 or 10000 points respectively to unlock them. If you struggle doing so you can hit up your friends and play the mode in 2-4 player co-op. 
Tip: Use the camera keys to check your surroundings (and check the controls menu, there's 2 new buttons!).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023786/54f10fd3ccd3de538a4925e860ce50602dc45257.png


For the main mode (now referred to as Adventure) you will now have access to different themes, day, night and night+rain. Alternatively, you can leave the theme on auto shuffle and the weather will change dynamically and be synchronized for all players. (No effect on gameplay.)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023786/6431098a793b1f8d2348096e3c4981eb34a9a8a6.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023786/271410fd20e46fee8894680893c67db1cfc9018c.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34023786/04957a4508800aa36dd6a6f80e2443bb41dfe753.png

The update features various other improvements and bug fixes, including an automatic backup system for your experience points and unlockables, an invisible map mode (for the daring players), revamped menus and a new underlying more robust and more flexible system for accepting invites and joining games.

Additionally, the game now supports 4 new language options: Thai, Turkish, Traditional Chinese and Czech.

More content is in development!

Have fun and good luck!

notes.title: Patch 13 - new achievement
notes.notes:
Dear pogo friends!

Thank you everyone for playing, you are doing great!

Since launch there have been quite a few patches, most of them being bug fixes or quality of life improvements.
The only changes to the level have been and will be the two safety vines added to the grapes section at 20%+ (btw the grapes are in fact apples).
I intended people to struggle, possibly for hours, yet I wanted them to progress and succeed as well. Most people quit the game there, some of them trying for 12 hours or more to get past the grapes.
Is is a very difficult game still (as intended) but the difficulty spiked too quickly at that point in the game.

Apart from that the Tick Tock achievement (which no one had gotten yet) has been replaced with the Goldfinger achievement. Achievements are tricky to get on purpose, Tick Tock went way overboard with difficulty though and as the grapes section changed I found it appropriate to replace it.
Now you have to turn all (70) objects in the level into gold. In case you're missing a single object look around in the last 1/3rd section of the game, one of the objects is not as obvious as the others!
When you do try and get the achievement make sure you're playing on Patch 13 and up (Options -> Miscellaneous -> Version).

⛰️ Have fun and see you at the summit! ⛰️
